title: Quartz Crystal Micro-balance with Dissipation factor monitoring \(QCM_D) for Cancer control Protocol
protocol: Wash crystal quartzes three times with ethanol.
Dry quartzes with Argon.
Incubate quartzes overnight at 4°C with 2 mM cysteamine.
Wash quartzes again three times with ethanol to remove unbound cysteamine.
Dry quartzes with Argon.
Transform plasmids DNA coding for GST tagged proteins into Escherichia coli.
Purify DNA using the NucleoPrepII anion exchange resin.
Prepare NAPPA printing mix with 1.4 μg/ul DNA, 3.75 μg/ul BSA, 5 mM BS3 and 66.5 μg polyclonal capture GST antibody.
Prepare negative controls by replacing DNA in the printing mix with water.
Incubate samples at room temperature for 1 hour with agitation.
Print samples on cysteamine-coated gold quartz using the Qarray II from Genetix.
Perform in vitro transcription and translation (IVTT) using HeLa lysate mix according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate the quartz, connected to the nanogravimeter inside the incubator, for 10 min at 30°C with 40 μl of HeLa lysate mix for proteins synthesis.
Acquire the conductance curve (IVTT addition curve) prior to protein expression.
Decrease temperature to 15°C for a period of 5-10 min to facilitate proteins binding on capture antibody.
Acquire the conductance curve (IVTT addition at 10 min) after protein expression.
Remove quartzes from the instrument.
Wash quartzes at room temperature in 500 mM NaCl PBS for three times.
Capture proteins on the quartzes.
Wash quartzes in PBS at increasing concentrations at 22°C.
Acquire the conductance curve "Post-wash curve" after the final washing process with PBS.
